verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that CSC scans received SOP documents, time-stamps them, and delivers them electronically as searchable PDFs. None of it states that these received notices are kept in the account for later retrieval. The 24x7 CSCNavigator access applies to annual-report filed evidence (outbound filings), and the AI document management covers user bulk imports. Both are adjacent features that do not establish an archive of received documents.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, received documents stay archived in the account so a notice can be retrieved months later, not just at notification time
